faqs.question: How many screens do you have?
faqs.answer: Movie Bash consists of 3 screens per branch (Couple, Celebration, Family).

faqs.question: What if we book and postpone the event date?
faqs.answer: Must be informed at least 72 hours before your scheduled time slot.

faqs.question: Is alcohol served / smoking permitted?
faqs.answer: No, strictly prohibited across all premises.

faqs.question: Age restrictions?
faqs.answer: 18 and above. Below 18 allowed with family members.

faqs.question: Is outside food allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes, outside food is allowed and you can also order via Swiggy/Zomato.

faqs.question: Is 2-wheeler & 4-wheeler parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes, convenient parking is available at both branches.

faqs.question: Can we bring pets?
faqs.answer: No pets are allowed inside the theatres.

faqs.question: What if a technical issue occurs during the event?
faqs.answer: Partial refund or rescheduling is provided as per terms and conditions.

faqs.question: What decorations do you have?
faqs.answer: Love, Birthday, Anniversary, Celebration themes etc., and custom as per customer requirements.

faqs.question: What add-ons do you have?
faqs.answer: Cake, snacks, food, fog entry, cold fire, special decoration, baby cart entry, car entry etc.

faqs.question: When can we book add-ons?
faqs.answer: While booking the room or anytime up to 24 hours before the event.

testimonials.review_text: Great place to spend time with friends and family on a special day. Lovely decoration, cozy and neat, great service, easy to book and add on. Outside food is allowed and you can use your own OTT platforms.
One of the best places to celebrate. Booked the couple theatre for 4 members; the fog effect and everything was amazing.
Good arrangements, great for surprising loved ones. Thanks for making my husband's birthday memorable.
Amazing experience for our anniversary. Fog entry, cake, decoration and photo shoot were fabulous.
